name: Tabernacle
overview: The Tabernacle, as instructed by the Lord to Moses, was a divinely ordained sanctuary constructed through willingly given offerings of precious materials such as gold, silver, brass, fine linens, and shittim wood. This mobile Tent of Meeting served as a sacred place where the Israelites, including all males, were to appear before God regularly, embodying God's presence among His people and providing a tangible focus for worship and covenant relationship.
